name: std_strncat
signature: char* std_strncat(char* dest, const char* src, int count)
summary: Appends src to the NUL-terminated string in dest, copying at most count bytes and always writing a terminator when the budget runs out. This is the Thumb CRT strncat used all over the model/UI code.
evidence: Thumb leaf: first loop scans dest for its NUL, second copies src bytes until count hits 0 then writes 0. 12 callers including 0x00222E90, 0x002232FC, 0x002C5E40 and CRT callers at 0x006105B4/0x00707A7C; exact strncat semantics.

name: Container_HashTableInsert
signature: void* Container_HashTableInsert(Container* table, const void* key, u32 value)
summary: Inserts a key (and optional value) into the engine hash table, growing/rehashing the bucket array when the load factor is exceeded and returning the stored bucket.
evidence: Calls the CRT memory/string helpers 0x0010E540, 0x0010EC00, 0x0010EC14, 0x0010EE9C, 0x0011142C and 0x00115358; same call pattern as 0x001E88E4 (string hash map insert). 0x0010F050 removes entries from the same container layout (+0x18 owner, +0x2cc bitmask, +0x2d0 count).

name: Mem_AllocAligned
signature: void* Mem_AllocAligned(u32 size, void* heap, u32 align)
summary: Aligned heap allocation: rounds the request, allocates size + align + 8 bytes so an 8-byte header can hold the original pointer, and returns the aligned payload. It is the single allocator used by nearly every constructor in this batch.
evidence: Signature is preserved as three arguments (size, heap, align); calls 0x0011CFAC (round size), stores the original block in the 8-byte header and returns header+8. Called by ~100 constructors, always with a struct size and an alignment of 4/8/0x10.

name: maybe_Container_RemoveSmallSetEntry
signature: void maybe_Container_RemoveSmallSetEntry(u32 owner, int element, Container* set)
summary: Removes one of at most four tracked elements from the container's 4-bit occupancy set, clears the bit and decrements the live count. The index is derived from the element address relative to the container.
evidence: Index = (arg2 - set - 0xa8) / stride via the magic constant g_0010f0c4, shifted by 0x27 and required to be < 4; tests 1 << index against set+0x2cc, calls 0x00114C58 to release the slot and decrements set+0x2d0. Small-set semantics are clear, the owner type is not.

name: maybe_Mem_PoolDestroy
signature: void maybe_Mem_PoolDestroy(Pool* pool, u32 block, u32 count, u32 flags)
summary: Releases a pool block: walks the pool's free/used lists, merges neighbouring free chunks and disposes of the pool descriptor. Called when a small-set entry is removed and from pool teardown.
evidence: Callees 0x0011ADAC (pool init), 0x0011AE20 and 0x0011AE5C (list link/unlink); global g_00114cec; caller 0x0010F050. Free-list merge logic, but the exact pool API name is inferred.

name: maybe_Mem_PoolInit
summary: Initializes a memory pool descriptor: fills the free list over the backing block and sets the sentinel/end pointers.
evidence: 0xB0 bytes, callee 0x0011FE34 (block fill), global g_0011ae10, caller 0x00114C58. Same descriptor layout that 0x00114C58 tears down.

name: maybe_Container_ListAppend
summary: Links node at the tail of an intrusive doubly-linked list, patching the previous tail and the list head.
evidence: 0x2C-byte leaf that calls 0x0011AE18 (list splice) and 0x0011FE24; caller 0x00114C58. Pointer patching matches a tail append.

name: maybe_World_EnsureTimeZoneState
summary: Lazily creates the global world/time state object keyed by the supplied name and returns 1 when it had to create it, 0 when it already existed.
evidence: Returns undefined1; allocates via 0x0011CFAC/0x0011FE8C and calls 0x001DBCFC; uses globals g_00147164/g_00147168/g_0014716c and treats arg1 as a C string (name lookup). Subsystem guess only.

name: maybe_Map_CheckCellBlocked
signature: u32 maybe_Map_CheckCellBlocked(u32 x, u32 y, u32 mask, u32 flags)
summary: Tests whether a map grid cell is blocked: walks a table of 6-byte collision entries, consults a per-entry enable table, and returns 1 when blocked. On the free path it allocates a 24-byte cell node and stores the cell coordinates shifted left by 3.
evidence: Entries at self+0x14, id at +2 and flag bytes at 0/1/4; per-id table at self+0x2a70; node coords stored as short <<3 at +0x12/+0x14; allocator 0x00109DC8 and 0x001235A4. Caller-less leaf, so this replaces the earlier encounter-monster guess.

name: maybe_Field_CreateGridObject
summary: Allocates and default-constructs an instance of the 400-cell field grid class by installing the vtable at g_0016098c.
evidence: Allocator + 0x00579974 then *obj = g_0016098c. That vtable's slots 0x0018FC30/0x0018FC34/0x0018FC84 belong to 0x0018F974, the constructor that allocates the 400 x 0x40 cell array and geometry block.

name: maybe_Script_CreateIntTable
summary: Allocates a script integer-table object, installs its vtable and clears the 9 handle words at +0x20..+0x28 plus a 12-entry parameter array.
evidence: Sets vtable g_001611dc (0x75b34, methods 0x00193FA0/0x001941D0/0x00194220, the same family as 0x00193F54 Script_GetIntTable1) and calls 0x00100050(dst, g_001611e0, 0xc, 4) to build 12 entries.

name: maybe_Field_UpdateEffectColor
signature: void maybe_Field_UpdateEffectColor(Actor* actor, const EffectParams* params)
summary: Twin of 0x00181C94: on first use creates the effect handle for an actor, afterwards rewrites the effect colour/alpha floats (offsets 0x5b4..0x5c4) and notifies the attached effect list.
evidence: Ghidra merged the entry point into 0x00161974; the recovered body searches a child by type, calls 0x005F6E50/0x005F708C, writes RGBA float fields 0x5b8/0x5bc/0x5c0/0x5c4 from g_00225c80/g_00225c84 and loops calling 0x00225BF4. Colour semantics inferred from the four adjacent floats.

name: maybe_Container_CreateObject
summary: Allocates a container object, installs its vtable and initializes the embedded handle at +0x60 with the constant at g_00161dfc.
evidence: Allocator + 0x00579974, *obj = g_00161df8, obj[0x18] = g_00161dfc, obj[0x19] = 0. Vtable 0x75a6c8 slots 0x001E6C3C/0x001E6BE8/0x001E6C0C belong to FUN_001E6B34, next to the string-map code at 0x001E88E4.

name: maybe_Ui_CreatePanel
summary: Allocates and default-constructs a UI panel object by installing the vtable at g_001620a4.
evidence: Allocator + 0x00579974, *obj = g_001620a4; vtable 0x75e6ac slots 0x002A5448/0x002A53FC/0x002A5400 point into FUN_002A5244, in the 0x2A5xxx UI block.

name: maybe_Mem_CreatePoolObject
summary: Constructs an allocator/pool object, initializes the embedded handle at +0x60 through 0x0055A93C and returns the payload pointer (object - 0x60).
evidence: Installs vtable g_001622a0 (0x75f958, methods 0x002BD5A0/0x002BD558/0x0055A90C), calls 0x0055A93C(obj+0x60) and returns result - 0x60. 0x55A90C is inside FUN_0055A500, the allocator/pool code.

name: maybe_Field_CreateActorObject
summary: Allocates and default-constructs a field actor object by installing the vtable at g_00162778.
evidence: Allocator + 0x00579974, *obj = g_00162778; vtable 0x762fec slots 0x00315EDC/0x00315EB4/0x00315EB8 belong to FUN_00315BB8, which 0x001EB390 (field object resize) calls.

name: maybe_Sound_CreatePlayer
summary: Constructs a sound-player object: installs its vtable, initializes the embedded voice table at +0x60 via 0x0056EE88, clears the state word at +0x24 and returns the payload pointer (object - 0x60).
evidence: vtable g_00162dd8 (0x7730f8, methods 0x0046CFB0/0x0056ED58/0x0056EE60), calls 0x0056EE88(obj+0x60) then result->f_24 = 0 and returns result - 0x60; 0x56xxxx is the sound/audio function block.

name: maybe_Field_CreateTaggedObject
summary: Allocates an object, installs the vtable at g_00162e10 and zeroes the handle at +0x60.
evidence: Allocator + 0x00579974, *obj = g_00162e10, obj[0x18] = 0. Vtable 0x776a64 slots 0x004B3620/0x004B35D0/0x004B35F4 belong to FUN_004B3528; the Ghidra string annotation djw comes from the vtable target bytes, not from the object.

name: maybe_Field_InitSharedParams
summary: One-time initializer for a shared field parameter block: allocates a 500-byte object, installs its vtable and copies roughly one hundred global values from g_00168a50 into the block at offsets 0x1ec..0x1e8.
evidence: Guarded by self->f_e4 == 0; allocates 500 bytes, calls 0x0021C2DC, writes g_00168a48, stores self at +0x20, calls 0x00100050(dst, g_00168a4c, 0x18, 0x13) (19 x 24 bytes) and then copies field pairs from g_00168a50/g_00168a44. Caller 0x00206408.

name: Text_SetupDualLayers
summary: Binds the two main and two null text layers (txt_l1, txt_l2, null_txt_l1, null_txt_l2) into a widget's text system.
evidence: 0x10C bytes; literal strings 0x00177590 txt_l1, 0x001775A0 txt_l2, 0x001775A8 null_txt_l1, 0x001775B4 null_txt_l2; writes layer handles to g_00177588/g_00177598. Same shape as 0x0018FE5C and 0x00212CF0.

name: maybe_Field_SetupNpcActionVtable
summary: Installs the NPC-action vtable/type word on the object returned by 0x0019C8F4 and stores the companion constant at +0x2c.
evidence: obj = 0x0019C8F4(); obj[0xb] = g_00177744; obj[0] = g_00177748. Called only from 0x00177864 Field_SetupNpcActionScript, immediately after the NPC action object is created.

name: Field_SetupNpcActionScript
summary: Builds an NPC action object from script data: reads the action, appear, disappear and notice tables, allocates the action entries and installs the NPC-action vtable.
evidence: 0x4E4 bytes; strings action/appear/disappear/notice at 0x00177D10..0x00177D38; allocates through 0x00109DC8, parses with 0x0011142C/0x0011CCA0 and calls 0x00177720 (vtable setup) plus 0x001D0B50/0x001D101C.

name: Field_SetupEnemyAi
summary: Parses the enemy AI parameter tables into an actor: collision size, walk/stop and back-off rates, rush/chase speeds and wait/escape weights.
evidence: 0x6F4 bytes; strings collision, moveWa/backWa/moveSt/backSt, s_rush/s_chase, w_stop/w_esc at 0x00178124..0x001784xx; allocates AI nodes with 0x00109DC8 and table lookups via 0x0011CB38/0x0011CCA0.

name: Monster_SetupEcology
signature: void Monster_SetupEcology(Actor* self, const void* ecoTable, u32 a3, u32 a4)
summary: Applies monster ecology parameters to an actor: spawn/ecology chance plus main and sub colony setup from the ecoRn/ecoCh/ecoCoMain/ecoCoSub table entries.
evidence: 0x2C8 bytes; strings ecoRn, ecoCh, ecoCoMain, ecoCoSub at 0x00178DA8..0x00178DC4; allocates ecology state with 0x00109DC8 and looks values up through 0x00330F40/0x00331748.

name: Field_ApplyNpcActionState
signature: void Field_ApplyNpcActionState(Actor* self, const u8* state)
summary: Copies a 12-byte NPC action state into the actor and dispatches on the action id: idle/run/wait use the movement helpers, while operation actions create opeJo/opeFr objects and send the matching actor notification.
evidence: 0x37C bytes; copies state[0..5] to +0xc9..+0x329 and state[8..0x10] to +0x32c..; switch cases 0..0xb call 0x0017A508/0x0017A6EC/0x005E7848 and the object creation path uses the literal opeJo at 0x00179704 (opeFr at 0x0017970C); caller 0x001D43C0.

name: maybe_Field_SetEncounterParams
summary: Assembles a battle/encounter parameter block from the actor's monster record: copies the float stat block, tags it with the shortRange/battle names and queues it.
evidence: 0x3AC bytes; allocates 0x50 bytes via 0x00109DC8 then 0x004E5B3C; builds a stack structure from g_00179d4c..g_00179d64; uses strings shortRange (0x00179D66) and battle (0x00179D74) through 0x0011CCA0; calls 0x00336054/0x0046E8B8/0x0063EEAC.

name: Field_ApplyMovementFlags
signature: void Field_ApplyMovementFlags(Actor* self, u32 mode, u32 a3, u32 a4)
summary: Writes an actor's movement mode and derived flags: selects walk/stop and back-off settings from the parameter table and updates the movement state.
evidence: 0x1E4 bytes; strings moveWa (0x0017A6D0), moveSt (0x0017A6D8), backWa (0x0017A6E0) plus g_0017a6e8; called from 0x00179398 and 0x0019C574; allocates a movement record with 0x00109DC8 and uses 0x002A8BA4/0x002B2F40/0x006D5CB0.

name: maybe_Field_CreateSmallEffect
summary: Creates a 40-byte field effect object (and, for actors above level 3, a 0x28 object) and submits it to the effect dispatcher when the actor is active.
evidence: Thumb entry with unaff_r4/r6 (Ghidra lost the ABI); allocates 0x28 via 0x00109DC8 then 0x004A7B7C, calls 0x002273B0 and 0x002A8BA4, and invokes vtable slot +4 on the created objects. Decompilation is incomplete, so only the object kinds are reliable.

name: Field_RegisterNpcActions
summary: Registers NPC action handlers from the action table, creating the nut/flw action objects and attaching them to the NPC.
evidence: 0x310 bytes; strings action (0x0018023C), nut (0x0018024C), flw (0x00180250); calls 0x001DC214/0x002273B0/0x002A8BA4 and allocates through 0x00109DC8.

name: Field_RegisterActorActions
summary: Registers the actor's turn and movement actions (rTurn/mTurn, move, talk) by building the corresponding action objects from the action table.
evidence: 0x3D4 bytes; strings action (0x001816F4), rTurn (0x00181700), mTurn (0x00181710), move (0x00181708), talk (0x00181718), nut (0x001816FC); calls 0x001DC3E0/0x00227C54/0x0036C2BC and allocates with 0x00109DC8.

name: Field_UpdateEffectParams
signature: void Field_UpdateEffectParams(Actor* actor, const EffectParams* params)
summary: Updates an attached effect's parameter block: on first use creates the effect handle, then writes the four colour/alpha floats (0x5b8..0x5c4) and notifies the effect list after adjusting the effect's timing fields.
evidence: Merged into the recovered 0x00161974 body: searches a child by type id, calls 0x005F708C/0x00225BF4, writes f_5b4/f_5b8/f_5bc/f_5c0/f_5c4 from g_00225c80/g_00225c84 and walks the list at +0x6b4. Names 0x00161974 and this entry are twins with different entry points.

name: maybe_Field_CreateActorSound
summary: Creates the 0xc0-byte actor sound/effect resource with a 28-byte configuration block (flags 0x10, 0xe, count 5, enabled) and binds it to the actor.
evidence: 0xC8 bytes; builds a 28-byte stack config (local_28..local_18) and calls 0x0030B120(handle, uVar4, &config); allocates 0xC0 with 0x00109DC8 then 0x0030BE18; global g_00182a24. Callers are the field actor constructors 0x00183C90/0x00184168/0x001846EC/0x001849F0.

name: maybe_Field_CreateActorData
signature: void* maybe_Field_CreateActorData(u32 id, const void* desc)
summary: Constructs a large actor/render data block via 0x00336A38 and fills it with default colour, flag and culling values, returning the interior pointer at -0x2b0.
evidence: 0x1C8 bytes; calls 0x00336A38(id, &local, g_00184c80); writes defaults 0xfffffff, 1, 0xff, 0xffffffff, 0xfffff800 over ~0x100 bytes and returns iVar5 - 0x2b0. Callers 0x004753E4 and 0x006C2B18.

name: maybe_Ui_FinalizeWidget
summary: Finalizes a widget: releases its child list and clears the layout/draw state before the object is freed.
evidence: 0xA4-byte leaf with no callees; walks the child list at +0x1c and clears handles at +0x18/+0x20 based on the mode argument. No strings or known callees, so the widget role is inferred from the surrounding UI block.

name: maybe_Field_CreateGridSystem
summary: Constructs the field grid system: installs the vtable, lazily allocates a shared cell pool, creates the collision/height sub-objects and builds a 400-entry cell array of 0x40 bytes each.
evidence: 0x2C4 bytes; *self = g_0018fc00 (vtable 0x758a60, slots 0x0018FC30/0x0018FC34/0x0018FC84), allocates a 0x10-byte-stride pool, builds 0x4000 bytes and calls 0x00100050(dst, g_0018fc2c, 400, 0x40); caller 0x001F0FEC. Grid geometry is plausible but not proven.

name: Text_SetupDualLayersDefault
summary: Variant of Text_SetupDualLayers that binds the same txt_l1/txt_l2 and null_txt_l1/null_txt_l2 layers but resets the layer handles to the defaults first.
evidence: 0xFC bytes; same four literal strings at 0x0018FF30/0x0018FF38/0x0018FF40/0x0018FF4C as 0x001774B4, with the handle clear path in front.

name: Script_GetIntTable1
summary: Returns an integer from the first of the three parallel script integer tables, creating/populating the table on first use.
evidence: 0x4C-byte leaf with callees 0x0011CCA0 (name lookup) and 0x00659668 (table access); identical structure to 0x00194300 and 0x0019434C, differing only in the global/table id.

name: Script_GetIntTable2
summary: Second of the three parallel script integer-table getters; same code as Script_GetIntTable1 with a different table id.
evidence: 0x4C bytes, callees 0x0011CCA0 and 0x00659668, byte-for-byte sibling of 0x00193F54 and 0x0019434C.

name: Script_GetIntTable3
summary: Third of the three parallel script integer-table getters; same code as Script_GetIntTable1 with a different table id.
evidence: 0x50 bytes, callees 0x0011CCA0 and 0x00659668, sibling of the two preceding getters.

name: Ui_BindGaugeParts
summary: Binds the gauge's fill and outline layers (gauge/out) and registers the gauge update callback.
evidence: 0x94 bytes; strings gauge (0x00194954) and out (g_00194950), layer handles g_0019494c/g_00194950; calls the layer binder 0x003E00CC/0x003E043C and 0x00649BD4.

name: Ui_SetupPagerTextLayers
summary: Binds a pager widget's text layers: four left columns, four right columns and the level-text layer, wiring each to its layout slot.
evidence: 0x564 bytes; literal layer names txt_l1..txt_l4, txt_r1..txt_r4, txt_lv_l1 at 0x00196F50..0x00196F90, plus further pager layer names; calls 0x003D2E2C and 0x001970E4/0x001A629C/0x001A6680.

name: maybe_Field_ReleaseResources
summary: Releases the field object's owned resources and returns a status flag indicating whether anything was freed.
evidence: 0x4C-byte leaf with no callees: tests the handles at +0xc/+0x10/+0x14, clears them and returns 0/1. Callers are the scene teardown routines 0x001A2FEC and 0x001A3760.

name: maybe_Monster_SetupEcologyForId
summary: Looks up the monster record for an id and forwards it to Monster_SetupEcology so the actor gets the spawn/colony parameters for that species.
evidence: 0x1A4 bytes; calls 0x00178B08 (Monster_SetupEcology) and 0x005E7848, reads globals g_0019c614/g_0019c618/g_0019c61c (lookup tables); argument is treated as a monster id.

name: maybe_Script_ResolveTwoIds
signature: void maybe_Script_ResolveTwoIds(ScriptCtx* ctx, u32 id1, u32 id2)
summary: Resolves two script ids to objects and fills a five-word result structure used by the caller's script command.
evidence: 0x154 bytes; callees 0x00116AE0 (fill), 0x0011CFAC/0x0011CFDC (allocation), 0x002D71AC (id lookup); writes a 5-word block at g_0019c864..g_0019c874. Called from the script table initializer 0x001E4A40.

name: Field_InitSceneObjects
summary: Allocates and initializes the scene's object tables for a loaded area: map data, actor list, collision grid and effect slots.
evidence: Largest function in the batch (0x1584 bytes); dozens of allocations through 0x00109DC8/0x0011CFAC, table builds with 0x00100050, area id copied into globals g_0019d6f4..g_0019d7xx; called by the map-jump path 0x001D9D7C.

name: maybe_Field_ApplySceneFade
signature: void maybe_Field_ApplySceneFade(Scene* scene, u32 from, u32 to, u32 flags)
summary: Drives a scene fade/transition: interpolates the change over the scene's timer and forwards the colour values to the renderer transition helpers.
evidence: 0x144 bytes; calls 0x001A178C, 0x002AC944/0x002ACED4 and 0x0061074C plus the 0x0066CD28/0x0066CD38/0x006F25xx helpers; global g_0019e458 stores the fade state.

name: Field_DestroyScene
summary: Tears down a field scene: releases actors, models, effects and map data, then clears the scene's own state.
evidence: 0x440 bytes; calls 0x001980E8 (resource release), 0x0011CFAC/0x0011FE8C (frees), 0x0010F6CC, 0x002E64xx and 0x001A178C; also called by 0x001A3760.

name: Field_DeleteScene
summary: Deletes a scene object: calls Field_DestroyScene and then releases the scene descriptor itself.
evidence: 0x28-byte wrapper: tail-calls 0x001A2FEC then 0x0010F6CC on the descriptor; global g_001a3784. Callers use it as the field-scene destructor.

name: maybe_Field_CreateMapObject
summary: Creates a map object from a definition id: allocates the object, resolves its model/placement data and registers it with the scene.
evidence: 0x16C bytes; allocates with 0x00109DC8, resolves the definition through 0x00319848/0x0062AE90 and parses names via 0x0011142C/0x0011CCA0; defaults written into g_001a49cc..g_001a49d8.

name: maybe_Field_CreateActor
signature: void maybe_Field_CreateActor(Scene* scene, const u16* def)
summary: Creates a field actor from a script definition record, initializing its transform, model and action state before adding it to the scene.
evidence: 0x270 bytes; allocates with 0x00109DC8, calls 0x0029E41C/0x002D1304/0x002D1F28/0x00319848, resolves names through 0x0011142C/0x0011CCA0; the definition is read as u16 fields.

name: maybe_Event_DispatchAction
signature: void maybe_Event_DispatchAction(u32 ctx, int* args, u32 a3, u32 a4, u32 a5, u32 a6, u32 a7)
summary: Forwards a seven-argument event/action request to the script dispatcher at 0x0053D4C4.
evidence: 0x6C-byte wrapper whose only callee is 0x0053D4C4; all five registers and two stack words are passed through unchanged. Also called as an action callback from the UI time-display setup.

name: Anim_CreateAnimSlots
signature: void Anim_CreateAnimSlots(AnimOwner* owner, int count, u32 a3, u32 a4, u32 a5)
summary: Creates count animation slots named anim_00..anim_NN and binds them to the owner so animations can be selected by slot index.
evidence: 0x74 bytes; format string anim_%02d at 0x001B653C; calls 0x003E00CC to bind each generated name and 0x006F0A50 to register it.

name: Gfx_InitVramBanks
summary: Initializes the GPU VRAM banks and display buffers from a configuration block, returning false when a bank cannot be reserved.
evidence: Returns bool; calls the 0x006B87F0/0x006B8BB0/0x006B8F8C/0x006B90A8/0x006B94D0/0x006B9Bxx bank setup routines and 0x0050E588; globals g_001b70a8..g_001b70c8 hold the bank descriptors; g_00140000 is the VRAM base.

name: maybe_Gfx_ResetRenderer
summary: Resets the renderer for a device and re-registers the render-pass callbacks and their state blocks.
evidence: 0xF8 bytes; calls 0x001F336C/0x001F33E0/0x001F3454/0x001F34C8 (four pass resets), 0x004FCC28/0x004FE06C/0x004FE3xx, and stores the descriptor at g_001b79e8.

name: maybe_Field_CreateRenderNodeA
signature: void maybe_Field_CreateRenderNodeA(u32 a1, u32 a2, u32 a3, u32 a4, u32 a5)
summary: Creates a render node through the shared 0x00193D84 constructor, installing the vtable at g_001b7a20.
evidence: 0x38-byte wrapper: calls 0x00193D84 with five arguments and writes g_001b7a20 as the node vtable. The sibling 0x001B7D60 uses g_001b7d9c.

name: maybe_Field_CreateRenderNodeB
signature: void maybe_Field_CreateRenderNodeB(u32 a1, u32 a2, u32 a3, u32 a4, u32 a5)
summary: Creates a render node through 0x00193D84 with a different vtable (g_001b7d9c), the sibling of CreateRenderNodeA.
evidence: 0x40-byte wrapper sharing the 0x00193D84 constructor with 0x001B79EC; only the vtable constant g_001b7d9c differs.

name: maybe_Ui_AddResourceEntry
signature: void maybe_Ui_AddResourceEntry(ResContainer* self, int parent, u32 flags)
summary: Allocates a UI resource entry, hashes/duplicates its name and inserts it under the given parent container.
evidence: 0x210 bytes; allocates with 0x00109DC8, uses the string helpers 0x0011CB38/0x001235A4/0x0012416C/0x00124D48/0x00124FA0 and 0x003882xx, writes globals g_001bbbe8..g_001bbc00; shape matches a tree/hash insert.

name: maybe_Ui_AddNamedEntry
signature: void maybe_Ui_AddNamedEntry(ResContainer* self, int parent, u32 name)
summary: Adds a named child entry to a resource container, hashing the name and linking the new node into the parent's child list.
evidence: 0x9C bytes; allocates with 0x00109DC8, uses 0x0011CCA0 (name lookup), 0x001235A4/0x00123660 (hash/insert) and 0x004BB77C; same container layout as 0x001BB9FC.

name: maybe_Ui_BuildResourceTree
signature: void maybe_Ui_BuildResourceTree(ResContainer* self, int parent, u32 def, u32 depth)
summary: Recursively builds a UI resource tree from a descriptor, adding entries and descending into child descriptors up to the requested depth.
evidence: 0x1B4 bytes; allocates with 0x00109DC8, calls 0x0011CB38/0x001235A4 (hashing) and 0x0047EA10/0x0063F60C (descriptor walk), uses globals g_001bc128/g_001bc130; depth is the fourth argument.

name: maybe_Model_UpdateAttachedParts

evidence: 0x4A0 bytes; literal strings txt_play, txt_play_num, txt_win, txt_win_num, txt_monster1/2, txt_medal, txt_smith, txt_item, txt_recipe, txt_title at 0x0024140C..0x00241510; layer ids are built as (u16 self+10) << 16 | index and bound through vtable +0x34 and +0x5c.

name: maybe_Ui_UpdateTransition
signature: void maybe_Ui_UpdateTransition(int self, u32 a2, u32 a3, u32 a4)
summary: Advances a UI/world transition: when the two timer fields differ it updates the transition target and flags, otherwise restarts the animation through the transition helper.
evidence: 0x7C bytes; compares obj+4 fields 0xd58/0xd5c, calls 0x0029D100, 0x006D7A90(obj+0x13c, obj+0xd80, g_0025777c[8], g_0025777c[0xc], 1) and sets f_10=1/f_15=3; fallback calls 0x001C3128(self,0x27,0x2f,arg4). Region and callees are UI/animation, role not proven.

name: maybe_Ui_UpdateCharaStatus

name: maybe_Save_CreateSlot
summary: Creates and initializes a save-slot object, linking it into the save-slot list.
evidence: 0x5C-byte factory: calls 0x001FF200 and 0x003CDD68, stores g_002658cc. Region and caller chain suggest save/slot management, but no strings prove it.

name: Ui_InitWindowManager
summary: Initializes the UI window manager: allocates the window table, installs the window factory entries and links the manager into the global UI state.
evidence: 0xB40 bytes; uses 0x00100050 to build arrays, allocates with 0x00109DC8/0x00123594, calls 0x0021C2DC and 0x0027B86C (window registration); directly precedes the per-window constructors 0x0027B508..0x0027DF28.

name: maybe_Ui_InitFourSubWidgets
summary: Initializes four equally sized sub-widgets (0x48-byte stride), each bound to the window's shared layout and state, then sets their parent link.
evidence: 0x60 bytes; loop i = 0..3 over self + i*0x48: calls 0x003900D4(&elem->f_294, i, &self->f_98, self->f_10, &self->f_d4, self), sets elem->f_2c4 = self+0x3c4 and calls 0x0038BF68(&elem->f_294).
